29. Buddha recitation method

Old Venerable Hai Hien was illiterate, had never chanted sutras, and had never heard others preach the sutras. He only recited a Buddha's name for 92 years. He recited Buddha's name almost without resting, just when he was awake he recited Buddha's name. His job is farming, every day he works in the fields, but the Buddha's words in his mind are not interrupted. Reciting Buddha does not hinder work, work does not hinder reciting Buddha, this is a good example for people studying Pure Land to seek rebirth in the Pure Land.

He tells us a truth: The Western Pure Land of Ultimate Bliss says in the classics, it really does! He met Amitabha Buddha. He asked Buddha to take him to the World of Ultimate Bliss. Amitabha Buddha did not take him away, telling him that he should continue in the world to preach the Dharma. The meaning of the Dharma representation is to set an excellent example, so that everyone can see the arising of faith, making vows to seek birth in the West. This is the way He saves sentient beings.

Why can we rebirth? Why is it possible to go to the World of Ultimate Bliss as a Buddha? Because we are inherently Buddha, the self-nature of sentient beings and the self-nature of Buddha are one and the same. It's just that because we are deluded and do not know this truth, we follow our afflictions and become the way we are today - a suffering being in the six realms of samsara. If we follow the teachings and proclaim Tathagata's nature, then we will reach the World of Ultimate Bliss and become Buddhas.

The Ten Dharma Precepts are dignified, whether we become a Buddha, a Bodhisattva, or a human, an animal, or a hungry ghost, it's all up to us to decide. The causes of the ten dharma realms are also the seeds in the Alai family consciousness, we all have them, lacking nothing, full and perfect. Buddha introduced these ten dharma realms to let us know clearly, about which path to choose, which seed to hope to take root, sprout, grow, flower, bear fruit, it's all up to us to choose, to persevere ourselves, not to be controlled by others, the initiative is in our own hands, Buddha, Bodhisattva are just increasing the above conditions for us, so it is said that Buddha does not save sentient beings. For sentient beings to become Buddhas, they save themselves.

Below the ten dharma realms are hell, hungry ghosts, animals, asuras, humans, and heavens. These are the six realms. Above are Sravakas, Pratyekabuddhas, Bodhisattvas, and Buddhas.

The first three of the six realms are the three evil paths, the last three are the three good paths. There are ten good actions that are directed towards the good realm, ten good karma with three aspects: body, speech, mind, friendly karma i.e. not killing, not stealing, not committing adultery, good speech karma i.e. not false speech, not double words, not evil speech, not dependent on speech, good intention karma means not greedy, not angry, not ignorant. Good means following morality, that is to say, these ten good actions are all actions following morality.

Among the six realms, the heavenly realm is the most good, to be born in the heavenly realm is to cultivate the ten good qualities, plus compassion and joy, this is the great good person of the world, the truly good person, who can forget himself for others. Next is the human world, cultivating the ten good middle grades, being able to maintain the five precepts or practice kindness, righteousness, wisdom and trust that ancient Chinese people talked about, and still not lose their human body in the next life. Cultivating the asura realm is between good and evil, cultivating the lower level of the ten virtues. In fact, asuras are similar to gods and humans, they also practice the ten virtues, but when they practice the ten virtues, they bring with them arrogance, aggressiveness, jealousy and resentment (if they do not suit them, they resent them and even want revenge), so in the ten virtues they have evil thoughts.

Going down, ignorance is born in the animal world. Stupidity means not clearly distinguishing between evil and falsehood. Stupid people who listen to the sutras and read the sutras are few and do not have wisdom. People with a heavy greedy mind, greedy for the five desires and six senses, greedy for wealth, form, name, food, will be born in the demon realm. The cause of anger is hell, and the most serious anger is pride and jealousy.

This is the karma condition of the ten dharma realms.

Normally speaking, 70 - 80% of people who abandon evil practice good deeds and accumulate virtue are reborn in the Dao Loi heaven. The Chinese call the Dao Loi god the Jade Emperor the Great. Heavenly Dao Loi blesses you with great treasures, everyone enjoys freedom and long life. One day in Dao Loi heaven is one hundred years in our human world, one year in Dao Loi heaven is also 365 days, the lifespan of the gods there is one thousand years.

Buddha tells us that although heaven is good, it is not yet final. Even if our lifespan is longer, there will be an end to it. When our lifespan comes, what should we do? Can't level up, only depravity. Therefore, all Buddhas, Bodhisattva of great compassion, for we present to the World the Western Pure Land of Ultimate Bliss.

This World is pure good, there is no evil, living in this World is full of Buddha and Bodhisattva. When we are reborn to the World of Ultimate Bliss, we become A Duy Viet Tri Bodhisattva. A Duy Viet Tri is a Sanskrit sound, translated means "Imever going back", this is the Dharmakaya Bodhisattva, Bodhisattva has a very high status. This position is too high, the method of practice is too easy, ordinary people can achieve non-regression in one lifetime, all thanks to the power and blessings of Amitabha Buddha. So this opportunity is truly rare and absolutely should not be missed. Therefore, Venerable Patriarch said: "The reason why the Tathagata emerged into the world is to speak only of Amitabha's sea of vows." Shakyamuni Buddha Buddha appeared in this world precisely because he introduced us to the Western Pure Land and advised everyone to seek rebirth in the Western Pure Land of Ultimate Bliss.

This method is unbelievable, rebirth to the World of Ultimate Bliss does not rely on one's own power, it depends entirely on the power of others. Even though it depends entirely on other people's power, if we don't really believe, really make vows, really recite Buddha's name, Amitabha Buddha's power cannot help us, that is to say, if our own mindfulness power is not sufficient, we cannot form one body with Amitabha Buddha's vow power. Even if Amitabha Buddha's vow power is greater, there is no way to help us rebirth. Therefore, the Pure Land Dharma Gate is also called the Dharma Gate of Two Powers. Our own power is the memory of Buddha reciting Buddha's name, controlling our afflictions and habitual energy, reaching the point of dissipation, and being born in the Western Pure Land of Ultimate Bliss. This is the power of Amitabha Buddha. This is what other Dharma methods do not have.

In the Infinite Life Sutra Shakyamuni Buddha Buddha said: “The mind sees the Buddha, the mind acts the Buddha”, this is based on the theory of Pure Land Dharma. Our mind is the true mind, the "mind and heart of Buddha", the original good nature that the Chinese say. Now we recite Amitabha Buddha, rebirth to the World of Ultimate Bliss, as “the mind-creating Buddha”. I was originally a Buddha, now I want to be a Buddha, there is no reason why I cannot become a Buddha! The meaning of “Buddha” is enlightenment, “the eye of the Buddha” is also the “eye of sight”. But now we are "eyes, eyes, eyes, eyes", not enlightenment. Delusion is living beings, enlightenment is Buddha; Once sentient beings become enlightened, they become Buddhas.

"Believing, vowing, reciting the name" is the great path to rebirth in the Pure Land, seeing Amitabha Buddha become a Buddha, "retaining the name" is sincerely reciting the Buddha's name, like the Venerable Hai Hien. If we can persevere and not retreat throughout our lives, we can definitely become Buddha in this life.

30. The practice method of Tinh Tong Hoc Association

The practice method of the Pure Land School is "Developing Bodhi mind, single-mindedly reciting Amitabha Buddha". This method is simple, easy, direct, convenient, ultimate, and has perfect retribution - to reach the Pure Land to become A Duy Viet Tri Bodhisattva.

Among the 28 heavens of heaven, any heaven cannot be compared to the World of Ultimate Bliss, the Heavenly Lord Dao Loi, the Great Brahma Heavenly King, the Heavenly King Ma He Thu La Heaven, these are all reaching the pinnacle of wealth in the six paths, no one can be superior, but compared to the low-rank Bodhisattva who is reborn in the Western World, whether it is wisdom, or morality, or supernatural power, the difference is very high!

rebirth The world of Ultimate Bliss is easier than birth in heaven. Pure Land Dharma practice is entirely thanks to the powerful blessings of Amitabha Buddha's original vow, the first condition to rebirth the World of Ultimate Bliss is faith, vow, reciting the name; What about heavenly birth? Faithful vowing to uphold the name cannot be born in heaven. To be born in heaven, one must abandon evil and practice goodness, cultivate the ten good karma of the highest level, that is, one must have a good mind, good words and good actions of the highest quality, to be able to be born in heaven. The Five Rings, Five Permanences, Four Virtues and Eight Virtues of China's Old Ancestors often said that if one can seriously study and achieve 80 to 90%, then one can be born in heaven; If you can do 50 to 60%, it's still human. Therefore, we know that Amitabha Buddha's 48 vows help us become Buddhas, His kindness to us is truly too great!

Specifically, the practice method of the Pure Land Dharma, Buddha said there are 16 methods, including the last method, which is to teach us reciting the name of Buddha, which is also reciting the name "Namo Amitabha Buddha", or just reciting the four words "Amitabha Buddha". “Namo” means refuge, refuge, worship, Buddha's name has only four words "Amitabha Buddha". Just recite sincerely, use a sincere mind, a pure mind, and a reverent mind - this is called mindfulness, it can help us turn evil into good, turn delusion into enlightenment, turn ordinary people into saints, Buddha's name has such great merit!

If you really want to rebirth the World of Ultimate Bliss, how much time will it take? In the “Amitabha Sutra” it says:

"Weakness on one day, weakness on two days, weakness on three days", until "weakness on seven days". The word "seven" here is not a specific number, it represents completeness.

It is recorded in the scriptures that many people recite Buddha's name for three days and then are reborn. Why did Venerable Hai Hien recite the Buddha's name for 92 years? That was the mission Buddha gave him.

Others asked Him: “You have met Amitabha Buddha, did Buddha say anything to you?”

The Venerable replied: “I asked Old Buddha Gia to come pick me up, but he did not agree, he said he would let me stay in the world to demonstrate the Dharma.”

Venerable Hai Hien's practice method is very effective in today's times. He alone diligently and silently practiced asceticism, with a pure mind, equality, freedom, helping sentient beings in need, working diligently. All his life he did not need money. He also told others that to truly study Buddhism, one must maintain the precepts and endure suffering; Can't maintain the precepts, can't endure suffering, can't really study Buddha.

He did not do Buddhist repentance sutras or Dharma conferences. Whether working or dealing with others, he never left the Buddha name in his mind. He cultivated the habit of reciting the Buddha name in his mind, never losing it. For Venerable Hai Hien, life is practice, work is practice, dealing with people is also practice, his method of practice is a phrase "Amitabha Buddha".

Venerable Hai Hien is truly the best example of a Pure Buddhist chanting Buddha. If a person who studies Buddha really wants to be reborn, he or she must study and follow Him; really want rebirth, the Buddha's effect cannot be interrupted.

Use your heart

How should I use my mind to recite Buddha?

Buddha hopes that we can use our true mind as human beings, not using false minds, false minds are the mind that arises and dies, is the mind of reincarnation, using false minds definitely cannot transcend samsara. Therefore, reciting Buddha must use the true mind, the true mind, the true mind, the true mind to recite the Buddha, the true mind to live, the true mind to treat people and things.

Using different minds, what is the difference in results? If you start thinking about harming others and benefiting yourself, self-interest, self-benefit - these are all causes of the six paths of samsara, three evil paths, in the next life you will definitely give birth to three evil paths; If you always think about how to benefit others, how to help others, how to achieve others, this is a good mind, using a good mind gives birth to the three good paths. If we abandon evil and cultivate good, but do not put evil in cultivating goodness in our mind, in our mind there is only Amitabha Buddha, in our mouth we can only recite this one sentence "Amitabha Buddha", no nonsense words, no nonsense thoughts, using Amitabha Buddha's mind to deal with people and things, there is no reason not to be born in the World of Ultimate Bliss!

Most people who recite Buddha's name have mouths and no minds, so if they are not in agreement with Buddha, this Buddha's name cannot be effective. Reciting the Buddha's name must always be in accordance with the mind and mouth. We must use sincerity and sincerity, Master An Quang tells us: "One part of devotion gets one part of the benefit, ten parts of devotion gets ten parts of the benefit", if you are sincere to the extreme, you will be able to connect with the Buddha.

Venerable Lao Duc used his true heart, others deceived him, teased him, bullied him, those people used their false minds, but Venerable Lao Duc completely used his true heart. Others trampled on Him and insulted Him, but He accepted them all. When he saw the Buddha, he bowed. Another person pointed to the buffalo dung and said: “Inside there is Buddha.” There is Buddha, I bow to the Buddha, he bows his head and bows to buffalo dung, his mind truly has the Buddha. Most people consider Him a fool, He is really not stupid at all. He completely used his true mind, so he received real benefits.

The biggest taboo in reciting the Buddha's name is using your mind to scatter thoughts. There are too many stray thoughts in your mind, too many random thoughts, then your mind will not be focused. A distracted mind reciting the Buddha has no merit, it is just planting a seed in the alai family formula, which cannot be used in this life. Master An Quang compassion, tells us to use the method of ten thoughts, from the first sentence to the tenth sentence, recite clearly, remember clearly, listen clearly, this method can calm the mind, not letting distracting thoughts interfere.

Why are there bad thoughts? Because you don't let go, you have a lot of things to worry about. If you truly let go, the distracting thoughts will no longer exist; If you truly let go, then recite Buddha and see Buddha.

A pure mind, an equanimous mind, and an enlightened mind are all the true mind. If you let go of attachments, you will have a pure mind. With the world and the world, all dharmas no longer have attachments. You can depend on conditions and have a pure mind, which is the realm of Arhat. Let go of discrimination again and gain equality of mind, which is the Bodhisattva realm. In the end, when you start thinking, you let go, it is a great enlightenment, you clear your mind and see your nature, then you become a Buddha.

Why can't ordinary people let go? Because we don't clearly understand the truth, everything is considered real, and we don't know that phenomena in the universe are fake or impermanence, we can lose it at any time. Human life is impermanence, who can guarantee that we will still be alive next year? It cannot be guaranteed, if one breath is gone, it will be another life. Therefore, Master An Quang teaches us to put the word "Death" on our foreheads, which is to say to those who cannot let go. There really must be such a high situation, use this word every day to remind yourself, this person reciting Buddha will definitely be reborn.

How to cultivate a pure mind? Reciting Buddha. In the mind there is only Amitabha Buddha, except Amitabha Buddha does not put anything in the mind, then the mind is pure. Our eyes see colors, our ears hear sounds. When the six senses (eye, ear, tongue, body, mind) come into contact with the realm of the six senses (sight, sound, taste, touch), bringing all the external scenes into our mind is troublesome, our mind is moved, our mind is polluted; The moving mind is not equal, the polluted mind is not pure, so there can be no enlightenment, only delusion.

It's not that Buddha told us not to see or hear, it's not like that, but he wants us to see and hear but not keep it in our minds, always maintain purity, equality, enlightenment, restore our pure, equal, enlightened minds. Pure, equanimous enlightenment is the true mind, the Buddha's mind, this mind is the Buddha. To do so is to "see the Buddha's heart".

There is no distance between Buddha and us, no before or after; That is to say, Buddha and we are not separated in space and time - that's the truth. But why can't we see Buddha? There are obstacles, on Buddha's side there are no obstacles, we ourselves have obstacles. If we truly believe, truly wish, the false thoughts and distracting thoughts of this world are truly finished, and we want to see the Buddha. He immediately appears, then we can see.

Great Master Nguoi Ich told us, whether we can rebirth or not, it must depend on our faith and vow. If we have faith and wish, we will definitely be reborn; High or low dignity, whether the effort in reciting the Buddha's name is deep or shallow, if the effort is deep, when reborn one can be reborn as a senior; If you let go a little, that effort will be exhausted and you will be reborn at a lower level.

We must clearly understand this fact and principle. Once we understand it clearly, we can choose the path we want to take in this life. Old Venerable Hai Hien has shown us that any person, whether young or old, smart or stupid, regardless of their nature, a single sentence "Amitabha Buddha" can achieve Buddhahood. Therefore, truly believe that there is the World of Ultimate Bliss, truly believe that there is Amitabha Buddha, making vows to pray for birth in Pure Land, at the end of our lives, Amitabha Buddha will definitely come to lead us to the World of Ultimate Bliss, in the World of Ultimate Bliss we will become Buddha in our lifetime.

Old Venerable Hai Hien in Nam Duong, most of them

Layman's Buddha Souvenir House on Yiwu Road. He always woke up at two o'clock in the morning, then lit incense, recited the Buddha's name, bowed to the Buddha, and circumambulated the Buddha. One morning, layman Liu saw a lot of incense sticks left in the incense burner after burning. Layman Liu was very curious, why is today not like every other day? While having breakfast, layman Liu asked the Venerable: “Why did you burn so much incense today?”

The Venerable said: “The secret of heaven cannot be revealed.”

Layman Liu became even more curious, so he hugged the old Venerable and insisted that he tell him. Layman Liu assured the old monk that he would not say it out loud.

Pausing for a moment, the Venerable said to layman Liu:

Sometimes it was the top and bottom chanting Buddha, leading him to chant Buddha. The Venerable also told Dharma Master An Chi: People in heaven are reciting Buddha, people in heaven are reciting the Infinite Life Sutra, people on earth are reciting Buddha, heaven and earth are merging into one body, forming one body.

The Venerable's practice of reciting the Buddha purely, without any impurities, allowed him to see that all dharmas are Amitabha Buddha. Reciting the effort into pieces, in the mind there is only one sentence "Amitabha Buddha", besides "Amitabha Buddha" there are no other thoughts, then at this time Buddha appears. All dharmas are born from the mind, Buddha is not from the Western World

Ultimate Bliss comes here, Buddha does not travel, it is "depending on the place of birth, depending on the place of destruction", this is the truth of all dharmas.

In October 2012, a few months before the Venerable's rebirth, when the Nam Duong lay people visited the Venerable, a few young lay people asked the Venerable to recite Buddha's name to see if they had any response. Everyone was very interested in this.

Things like induction are rare, don't expect them, whether they are real or fake. If we seek these things, we will fall backwards, because they disturb our pure mind, pollute our pure mind, they make us lose our equanimity, this is a big obstacle for us, so the Venerable said "don't seek".

A young laywoman who was very hopeful couldn't help but interrupt and say: “Tell us!”

The old Venerable smiled and said to her: “Tell you? That cannot be said, it cannot be said!”

Having finished speaking, His face became serious. “If you talk too much, that's not good, it will shorten your life in the future. How do you know the destiny? Once you see it, don't say anything." "Khau complacency" means to talk arrogantly and brazenly, this is a Indonesian proverb.

This female laywoman was not willing and asked another question:

“So have you seen the Western Pure Land of Ultimate Bliss?”

The old monk did not answer her directly, turned his head over there, looked at the lay person next to him and continued: "It's dark, what do you see? What did Buddha Gia say to you? Don't say it!" The Venerable said as he shook his hand.

People who are quick to speak will not speak. Don't say! If you recite with one mind without disturbance, Old Buddha Gia knows it all. If you practice well, people will know clearly in their hearts, they will all look at you, they will all follow you! - Honestly chant Buddha!”

People were no longer interested in knowing about the related realms. The first time the lay person met, he was reminded by the old monk to "manage your mouth". There are also many examples of people who, after achieving complete success, still have a life span, but no longer need it. May Amitabha Buddha lead them to rebirth.

32. bowing to the Buddha means bowing to one's own nature

In the spring of 2012, the young man picked up a noodle while eating and went with his friend to Lai Buddha Pagoda. Seeing the Venerable Hai Hien sitting in the mending room, he immediately walked straight in to pay his respects. The old monk stopped him and asked: “Have you gone bowing to the Buddha yet?”

"Not yet."

The old monk pointed to the cushion on the ground and said: “I bowed to the Buddha first.”

The young man moved the cushion on the ground to the Buddha statue and bowed three times. The Venerable looked at him standing up after bowing, smiled and said: “I've shown you how to bow to the Buddha, you still haven't learned it yet! - Bowing to the Buddha must be like a tissue cable, the spine must be straight."

The young man hastily bowed to the Venerable and assured the Venerable that: "I remember, bowing to the Buddha will definitely meet standards in the future."

The old monk kept talking: “Good, good!” Then deliberately explain to him: “The tissue cable is that toad!” Makes everyone laugh endlessly.

Every time someone paid homage to the Venerable, he would smile happily and say: “Don't bow to ordinary monks like me, bow to the Buddha!” Whenever he saw the posture of the lay people in chaos and no dignity, he would immediately explain to everyone: “Bowing to the Buddha must have a sincere heart, a straight spine, so that the cup of water does not spill, and when bowing, the posture must be like that of a toad.” He spoke and demonstrated several times for everyone to see.

Bowing to the Buddha is also a method of practicing Buddha Dharma. Bowing to the Buddha and worshiping the Buddha are all blessings. When bowing to the Buddha, although the body is moving, the mind is pure, there can be no thoughts in the mind, there can be no false thoughts. Beginners always have thoughts in their minds. At this time, they must let go of thoughts and concentrate on reciting "Amitabha Buddha". Reciting "Amitabha Buddha" is cultivating concentration. When reciting Buddha, focus on this Buddha phrase, don't let it distract, after a long time, the practice is deep, naturally there will be no more wandering thoughts, then success is achieved, it is called attaining concentration. Concentration can expand wisdom, the effect of concentration is wisdom, called human world attaining concentration, human concentration opens wisdom. One day Wisdom will appear - master of everything.

No matter how difficult the days were, Venerable Hai Hien's practice was never interrupted. Every day he lit incense, bowed to the Buddha, recited the Buddha's name, especially recited the Buddha's name, day and night without interruption. When he was tired of reciting, he went to bed to rest a bit. After resting, he sat up to continue reciting and bowing. Extremely flexible, extremely free, without any constraints: When you're tired, rest. After resting, continue working.

Old Venerable Hai Hien normally bowed to the Buddha without kneeling on the cushion. He always bowed to the Buddha on the ground. He was extremely sincere and respectful towards the Buddha. He said: “bowing to the Buddha means bowing to one's own nature, bowing to a pure mind!” One time, he was bowing to the Buddha at Luc Phuong Buddha Street in Indonesia. The lay people wanted to put a Buddha statue in his room. After listening, he said: "The main thing is that I have to recite Buddha's self-nature, then it will be successful."

Buddha is our true mind, our self-nature. We recite the Buddha, bowing to the Buddha, the main purpose is to recite the Buddha's self-nature, bow to the Buddha's self-nature. Amitabha Buddha is our true mind; When our mind chants "Amitabha Buddha", it is our mindfulness that is discovering our self-nature. Having recited the Buddha's self-nature, bowed to the Buddha's self-nature, is the clear mind to see the nature, then one has become a Buddha.

tom_tat: Shakyamuni Buddha Buddha teaches sentient beings by using his body and words. Venerable Hai Hien is extremely compassionate. He incarnately preaches the Dharma to us, also by his body and words. His teachings are important…
noi_dung:
33. Carefully recite

Shakyamuni Buddha Buddha teaches sentient beings by using his body and words. Venerable Hai Hien is extremely compassionate. He incarnately preaches the Dharma to us, also by his body and words. His teachings are the most important, to make everyone see; His teachings are to teach people to truly recite Buddha's name, maintain the precepts to recite Buddha's name, and let go of self-interest and self-interest. When someone came to ask him for advice, his answer was clear and concise, so that the listener could easily remember it and happily receive it.

Old Venerable Hai Hien normally does not like to talk, except when it comes to reciting Buddha's name. He often reminded those around him to "Diligence in reciting Buddha's name, becoming Buddha is a big thing, the rest is all fake"! This is the Venerable's first words, the words that the Venerable said the most. Whenever he has the opportunity, he uses this sentence to advise others, reminding everyone at every moment, which is truly compassionate to the extreme.

Buddha in Mahayana Buddhism tells us that the universe is fake, not real. In the Diamond Sutra it is described that: "The dharma of all existence is like an illusory robe and shadow, like a heron like electricity, and an eagle's action like a vision." This verse clearly states that the truth of the universe is a dream, its existence is like dew drops. As soon as the sun rises, the dew drops quickly dry up and are no more; Just like an electric flash, after the electric flash, not even a trace can be found. Therefore, it is said that the universe is not real, it is fake. Where does the universe come from? Where do all things come from? Where does life come from? Where did I come from? The Sixth Patriarch of Zen School, Master Huineng, during his enlightenment, said a few sentences, including the last sentence that answered the doubts, He said: "If our self-nature can give birth to all dharmas", it is unthinkable that our self-nature can give birth to all dharmas! That is to say, our self-nature can give birth to the universe, can give birth to all dharmas, can give birth to life. Where do I come from? It is the self-nature that appears.

Old Venerable Hai Hien clearly understood this principle. He often told others to recite "Amitabha Buddha". This Buddha sign is real, other than the Buddha sign, everything is fake. Master Tinh Khong said: "Only people with a clear mind and enlightened nature can say such words. This is the truth."

Since it's fake, you should let it go, there's no need to worry about it; really have to be sure, the World of Ultimate Bliss is real, Amitabha Buddha is real.

Chanting Buddha rebirth in the Ultimate Bliss world has become Buddha, this is the truth, the rest is all fake, nothing is real. Master Vinh Gia of the Tang dynasty said: "Dream Ly Minh Minh has six beasts, after enlightenment, there is no limit to the great heavens." “Dream” represents delusion, “enlightenment” represents enlightenment, the meaning of this saying is to say six paths of samsara, when delusion is there, after enlightenment, we know that there is originally no six paths of samsara. If a practitioner also wants this, wants that too, thinks this too, remembers that too, then it's troublesome. Old Venerable Hai Hien is wise, he doesn't think about anything, he doesn't need anything, it all depends on fate: If something is beneficial to sentient beings, do it if there is a predestined relationship; If you don't have fate, don't do it. Don't ignore fate.

The Venerable often advised people to diligently recite the Buddha's name. All those who were close to him, no matter how young or old, when he met others, always said this: "Just diligently recite Buddha's name, only need to diligently recite Buddha's name, only then can you leave suffering, can you be happy, can you go to a good place!" He also made it clear to everyone that reciting the Buddha must be recited with great effort in order to be able to freely rebirth in the West.

One day in the middle of autumn 2012, a few lay people from other areas came to Lai Buddha Pagoda. They came to the monastery and immediately went to ask about Venerable Hai Hien first. The Venerable was sitting there chopping wood. After everyone paid homage to him, he asked the Venerable to teach a few sentences to everyone. The old monk was still sitting there, chopping wood and saying: “There's nothing to teach, just diligently chant Buddha! There is nothing difficult in the world, just fear that the mind is not specialized. Everyone was very happy after hearing this and clapped their hands. He increased his tone and emphasized again: “There's really nothing difficult about it!”

The saying "There is nothing difficult in the world, just be afraid of an unspecialized mind" by the Venerable Hai Hien, increases the faith and aspiration of those who recite Buddha's name. "Specialized" is the most specialized, also means "One subject to penetrate, long to practice", only after a long time of cultivating will enlightenment occur, which is also what the ancients often said: "Reading books with many changes, strange meanings for self-understanding". These are the concepts and methods related to learning in the Chinese tradition: Conceptual theory is a profound subject that can be cultivated over time; The main method is to read the letters of various variations and see the meaning for yourself. Therefore, if you only need to penetrate one subject and practice for a long time, you will definitely be able to achieve it.

Old Venerable Hai Hien constantly told others that people who can recite Buddha's name are people with great merits and blessings, great good roots, they must grasp these great and good karma, he can truly recite Buddha's name and achieve success in this life!

Buddha preached the Amitabha Sutra as one of the three Pure Land Sutras, the sutra says: “It is impossible to minimize the merits and blessings of causes and conditions to attain rebirth in a foreign land.” In other words, the objects of Tinh Tong are people with good roots, merits and blessings, and predestined relationships. They just need to have all these three conditions, regardless of whether they are young or old, smart, stupid, idle, busy, there is no one who cannot achieve. What is goodness? The good root is wisdom. As soon as you come into contact, you don't doubt, you immediately believe, this is the good root; "Being honest, listening, doing things" is a natural talent, one is born with it, this is called good roots. What are merits and blessings? merits and blessings are concentration, pure mind, unpolluted mind; Be sincere with people, don't use false thoughts; Respect all. A person who has these three things - sincerity, purity, reverence, this person has blessings.

The Venerable also explained to everyone a koan passage in the Lotus Sutra: "If you call Namo Buddha, you will attain Buddhahood." The koan is saying that when Shakyamuni Buddha Buddha was still alive, there was a person who wanted to pray to Buddha to let him leave the home life in this world. Buddha asked his disciples who had just attained Arhat to observe whether this person had good roots or not. Arhat can see past lives, past lives... of others, a total of 500 lifetimes can be seen. The result everyone can see is that this person has not had a relationship with Buddha in 500 lifetimes. Without good roots, how can we study Buddha? But Buddha agreed to let him leave the home life, accomplished him leaving the home life, and told the crowd: In countless previous lives, he used to be a woodcutter, splitting firewood. One time, he encountered a tiger on the mountain, he climbed a tree to avoid danger, while not knowing what to do, he shouted "Namo Buddha"! It is this seed that is ripe today, so Buddha sent him away from home life.

The duration of countless eons, this time cannot be imagined in any way. The karma of the sentence "Namo Buddha" in countless past lives, until meeting Shakyamuni Buddha Buddha, ripened. So if there is a cause, there must be an effect.

Having finished speaking this koan, the Venerable repeatedly advised everyone to recite the Buddha's name. He said: “If you work hard to recite Buddha's name and practice hard, you can all become Buddha. If you don't practice, how can you do it? You have been doing the same thing as me for decades, every day when I wake up around three o'clock in the morning, I wake up and light an incense stick, I sit down and recite Buddha's name, then I switch to Buddha's circumambulation. When I'm tired of Buddha's circumambulation, I rely on that, relying on that and still chant Buddha's name. - It's not like you can practice well in just a moment!”

Old Venerable Hai Hien teaches others to recite Buddha's name, ready to remind people without fear of trouble. He looked at the lay people with compassion but urgently continued to advise: “You must diligently chant Buddha. After reciting the Buddha's name, then enter the Buddha's path to dedicating merit. Don't say, I'll just recite the phrase 'Amitabha Buddha', don't recite until my mind is unfocused, don't consider it reciting! People who don't study well will not succeed."

The Venerable reminded everyone to dedicating merit, what is dedicating merit? Buddha tells us that, using the merit of one's own life of practice, one does not seek anything, only prays for rebirth. The Western Pure Land of Ultimate Bliss, close to Amitabha Buddha, is called dedicating merit.
