48. If we want Buddha Dharma to flourish, only monks can praise monks

Old Venerable Hai Hien asked Amitabha Buddha many times to lead him to rebirth. Amitabha Buddha said he had practiced very well and asked him to stay in this world and teach the Dharma. When the time comes, he would definitely come to receive him. So when is that time? Waiting for him to come across this book called "If you want Buddha Dharma to flourish, only the Sangha praises the Sangha", the moment when the cause and condition for your Dharma teaching is complete, then the Buddha will come and guide you.

In this book "If Buddha Dharma is to flourish, only the Sangha praises the Sangha" Dharma Master Hoang Lam used a period of more than ten years to collect a lot of documents to compile, in which it answers the questions of those who questioned the collection of "Infinite Life Sutra" by lay practitioner Ha Lien Cu. Currently, at home and abroad, there are many people who oppose this compilation by layperson Ha Lien Cu, saying that Buddhist scriptures cannot be compiled. The data collected by Dharma Master Hoang Lam proves that this method of gathering Buddhist sutras existed in the past, and at that time it was called gathering sutras. Therefore, this collection is like reason like dharma, the appearance of this volume is necessary for the times.

Old Venerable Hai Hien stayed in the world precisely because of this final dharma. Of course, he was teaching the Dharma all his life, but the most important of them was the last time. At this point, His dharma manifestation merit was complete, Amitabha Buddha led Him to rebirth in the West.

What does this expression mean? First, prove that the collection "Infinite Life Sutra" by layperson Ha Lien Cu is the true sutra. The compilation "Sutra of Infinite Life" has been available for a long time, but there are errors. This compilation has no errors, every sentence and every word is verbatim from the sutra. Second, verify that the old layman Hoang Niem To's commentary with this compilation is truly trustworthy, and is the most perfect commentary among the commentaries on the "Infinite Life Sutra". This is a collection of mantras, a collection of sutras, treatises and commentaries of ancient virtue, truly right knowledge and right view. Third, because Dharma Master Tinh Khong has proven that for more than ten years he followed this sutra and commentary to practice, not wrong.

This is the mission Amitabha Buddha assigned to the Venerable Hai Hien, so that he could finally explain this dharma! This task is very large, the merit is unbelievable, it is related to the dharma fortune of Shakyamuni Buddha Buddha's end of dharma nine thousand years ago, at this time the old Venerable Hai Hien took on the important responsibility. The World-Honored One's Dharma ended nine thousand years ago. All sentient beings who study Buddha can achieve success in one lifetime, thanks to this Dharma.

The Infinite Life Sutra says: "Whatever happens in the future, the sutra will be completely destroyed, the ego will be compassionate and clear, and the sutra will stay for hundreds of years." “The future” is the final time after Shakyamuni Buddha Buddha's end of the thousand years of dharma. At that time, all the sutras in the world disappeared, but the compassionate World-Honored One specially left this sutra for another hundred years, which book was left behind? Master Tinh Khong tells us: "It is the 'Sutra of Infinite Life' that the old layman Ha Lien Cu gathered." He also said, "The collection and concentration of Niem Lao, confirms that nine thousand years after Shakyamuni Buddha's end of Dharma, the Dharma is the first in which sentient beings can be saved." "The end of the Dharma of nine thousand years was truly achieved thanks to this Dharma method, other Dharma methods could not do it."

Monks praise Sangha, this is a big deal in Buddha's family, the rise and fall of Buddha's teachings is in this generation. Chinese people often say that when a family is in harmony, everything is prosperous. When a family is in harmony, this family will definitely prosper, and so will the group and Sangha. If everyone can get along with each other, Buddhadharma will prosper; If we criticize each other, praise ourselves and criticize others, Buddha Dharma will perish. Therefore, if we want Buddha Dharma to flourish, only the Sangha should praise the Sangha!

Appendix. Bodhisattva body Dharma Master Hai Khanh

Shaman Hai Khanh, surname Ly, surname Phu Quy. The ancestors lived in Tat Duong district of Southeast Ha Nam province. Born in the year of Xuan Thong at the end of the Qing Dynasty (1909). Because he was born into a poor family, he never went to school, but he has a kind nature and is filial and respectful. 11 year old Dharma Master Truyen Dong left the home life at Thanh Luong pagoda, Arhat mountain in Nam Duong. At the age of 42, he entered Lai Buddha Pagoda as a permanent resident, specializing in Pure Land practice. He truly recited Buddha's name. In 1989, he received full ordination at Bach Ma Pagoda. On the 11th day of the 11th lunar month of 1991, freely born in the West. Life expectancy is 82 years old, Sangha is 71 years old.

According to Buddha's rules, after rebirth, he was placed in a large jar. Most of the time, after three years of opening the jar, if the body is not damaged, the whole body will be saved. If the body is damaged, then cremated and buried again. After 6 years and 9 months, Dharma Master Hai Khanh sat in the jar, his brother, Venerable Hai Hien, had the intention to open the jar. Unexpectedly, when he opened the jar of longevity, Venerable Hai Khanh's appearance was the same as when he was alive, even his clothes were not damaged at all. Everyone was extremely surprised and praised endlessly, so they took his body and worshiped it in Lai Buddha pagoda. In 2005, a lay person started making offerings to plate His body with gold.

Master Hai Khanh's physique is short and extremely gentle. The lay people all said:

"If we talk about frugality, Khanh Cong is not inferior to old Venerable Hai Hien." At that time, the conditions of the monastery were not good, it was extremely miserable. In the winter, Dharma Master Hai Khanh wore cotton clothes (this cotton shirt is currently kept in the Vajra shop of Lai Buddha Pagoda), in the summer he dressed simply, but all day he was cheerful and cheerful, often smiling. He did not like to talk, a lay person recalled saying: “Khanh Cong has a very good personality and has never caused trouble to others. Because he stutters a bit and doesn't say anything fluently, so he doesn't like small talk. But there is one point, when he chanted 'Amitabha Buddha' there was no stutter, so I just remembered that he liked to recite Buddha."

Dharma Master Hai Khanh stuttered seriously, but he recited this sentence "Amitabha Buddha" very clearly. When he recited Buddha, the sound was like a big bell, each word was round and clear, he only knew this one sentence "Amitabha Buddha".

Before the "Van Cach" period, Dharma Master Hai Khanh was sent to Truong Trang village next to Lai Buddha pagoda to participate in labor. Unable to recite Buddha during the day, he recited Buddha at night after everyone was asleep. One lay person recalled: At that time, he was very young, he liked to play with Master Hai Khanh, and at night he had to push the beds close together to sleep together. One time in the middle of the night, he woke up in a vague dream to go to the bathroom, saw Dharma Master Hai Khanh sitting cross-legged on the bed, startled, quickly went to beat Dharma Master Hai Khanh, asking him what he was doing. Khanh Cong said, during the day I am not allowed to recite Buddha's name, I take advantage of the night to recite Buddha's name a little.

All his life, Dharma Master Hai Khanh maintained the precepts of Buddha's name. Normally, he would recite "Amitabha Buddha", but if someone greeted him, he would reply to someone else as "Namo Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva", and it was always like that for decades.

Dharma Master Hai Khanh is extremely gentle, everyone in Phuong Vien respects him very much, but for some reason, there are people in the monastery who bully and insult him.

Dharma Master Hai Khanh was illiterate. Except for the Buddha's name, he did not know anything. When others entered the main hall, he only stood outside the main hall chanting Buddha. No one in the monastery took him seriously. The dirtiest and heaviest jobs in the monastery are all done by him, because the monastery also has a few acres of barren land, so people often see Dharma Master Hai Khanh carrying a basket and a shovel on his shoulder everywhere to clean up manure.

One time, a lay person came to Lai Buddha Pagoda, at that time the temple still had buffaloes plowing, someone pointed at Dharma Master Hai Khanh in the distance and said to her: "It's the person standing against the wall. The monk faces east. Everyone else looks down on him. He only knows how to clean up shit. He often returns to the monastery late for meals. When he has food, he eats a little, and when he runs out, he doesn't eat."

Shaman Hai Khanh often takes his tools out to clear manure, collect firewood, and pick up rubble to spread on the road. When he returned, the rice was cold and he ate a little. When the rice ran out, he was hungry for a meal. He never complained or got angry.

Foods such as fruit, dry cakes, and sugar cubes offered at the monastery, because the offerings take a long time, some of the foods become spoiled and moldy. Other people choose all the good things, and leave the rest to Dharma Master Hai Khanh, he is not angry at all. Someone said: “If you can't eat these foods, feed them to the buffalo!” Master Hai Khanh said: "The old buffalo pulling plows and harrows, eating dry grass, is miserable enough. I can't let him eat this food. If I can't enjoy it, I'm guilty of karma, I can't continue to harm the buffalo." So He buried all that food next to tree roots or scattered it in the fields. One lay person said: “The Venerable lives very frugally!” Master Hai Khanh said: "Buddha Patriarch is looking there, raising his head three meters away there is a spirit, all things have Buddha nature, so you should use it as you like."

In the winter of 1987, Dharma Master Hai Khanh was seriously ill. A monk from all over the world came to spend the night at the monastery, claiming to know how to predict fate. He said he had calculated that Dharma Master Hai Khanh's yang vision had ended. He told the cook in the street, it was best not to let Dharma Master Hai Khanh eat anymore, and also not to take medicine, take a bath and wait for death. Four days later, lay dharma protector Vuong Xuan Sanh came to the monastery and saw Dharma Master Hai Khanh lying on the bed breathing weakly. He asked him if he had eaten or not. He said: “Eat.” Layman Vuong immediately found old Venerable Hai Hien, one of them started a fire, the other rolled out dough to make noodles, and made a pot of noodles. Old Venerable Hai Hien sat on the bed of Dharma Master Hai Khanh, using his shoulder to support him. Layman Vuong slowly molded him spoon by spoon.

Shaman Hai Khanh ate four bowls at a time and gradually regained consciousness. Layman King asked him: “Drink again?” Master Hai Khanh said: “If there's still water left in the pot, you can drink a little more.”

Venerable Hai Hien and layperson Vuong both felt heartbroken and cried. The two of them were worried that Dharma Master Hai Khanh would try to drink, so they did not let him continue drinking. Layman Vuong wanted to go find that fortune teller and tell him something, but was stopped by Dharma Master Hai Khanh, who said: “This is all my karma, I can't blame anyone else.”

In the monastery, there was a monk who was originally a soldier and normally liked to scold others. He found that Dharma Master Hai Khanh was not pleasing to his eyes and often scolded him. Sometimes the lay people could not ignore it and immediately went to reason with the Venerable, but Dharma Master Hai Khanh only smiled softly and gently at the Venerable and scolded him: Master clears the karma obstacle for me, I will go to the land of Ultimate Bliss."

Look at the perfection of patience of Dharma Master Hai Khanh! Others bullied Him, defamed Him, teased Him, He thanked others for helping Him eliminate karma obstacles. His karma obstacles were truly eliminated, so he walked freely like that, leaving behind his flesh and relics. Not only did his body not rot, his clothes were also not damaged.

There was a 16-year-old child with the surname Dao who brought another child to the monastery to play. He saw that Dharma Master Hai Khanh was really old, so he cursed him with vulgar words and used a small stick to hit his head. Wizard Hai Khanh tilted his head, smiled and said: “Do you want to get married to me? Tell my parents, I accepted you as a disciple and taught you to recite 'Amitabha Buddha'. Go to school, do a good job, and when you grow up, your family will be rich forever."

Dating back to the 80s of the 20th century, Lai Buddha Pagoda still did not use tap water, the monks drank water from a self-dug shallow well. Whenever there is a drought, there is no water in the well, so we can only go to the village to fetch drinking water. One time, when Dharma Master Hai Khanh came to the village to fetch water, he was bitten by a dog until he was covered in injuries. The dog's owner found out and ran back, brandishing a whip in his hand to beat the dog. Shaman Hai Khanh stopped him and said: "This dog bit me when I saw it, proving that when I was a dog in my previous life, I bit it. Now it bites me back. This debt is about to end. If you beat it and make it resentful, then this resentment will continue, and the injury I suffered will be in vain." He asked the villagers for some flour to apply to the wound, borrowed a needle and thread to sew his clothes in a simple way, and then did not forget to take half of each bucket of water and carry it back to the monastery.

There was also one time, when Dharma Master Hai Khanh picked up dung next to a donkey that had been kicked to the ground, the donkey's owner rushed to help him up and asked him how he was injured.

Master Hai Khanh said: "I'm fine. Can you come quickly and see if the donkey's leg is injured?"

He truly treated people, things, and things with sincerity, equality, and respect. One day, Dharma Master Hai Khanh was carrying excrement, a young man riding a bicycle ran towards him. Because the speed of the bike was too fast, Dharma Master Hai Khanh could not avoid it and suddenly fell next to the ditch, feces splashing all over his body. This young man not only did not apologize, but also cursed Dharma Master Hai Khanh for falling in the ditch, saying he was blocking his way. At this time, someone was carrying a shovel across this street. When he saw this young man being rude and disrespectful, he wanted to swing the shovel and hit him. Shaman Hai Khanh lying in the ditch immediately spoke up to stop him, saying: “Don't hit him! Don't hit him! Don't blame him, it's all my fault!” Venerable Hai Khanh suffered disadvantages, others bullied him, he willingly accepted them, disadvantages are blessings, those who suffer disadvantages have blessings. From these things, it can be seen that his achievement is cultivating the paramita of patience. Diamond Sutra says: "All dharmas are selfless, attaining mastery."

Everyone in eight villages and ten miles away knows that Venerable Hai Khanh is loyal, honest, and has a gentle personality. Regardless of whether the villagers had problems, he wholeheartedly helped them to the end.

In early December 1973, the weather was cold. In Truong village, a calf that had just been born a few days ago fell into a well more than ten meters deep.

This is the only well in the village, with more than 300 years of history. The walls of the well are entirely made of green bricks, and the mouth of the well is surrounded by four pieces of bricks. There are many places on the wall of the well that have eroded into caves. While the baby was struggling, a piece of brick fell to the bottom of the well, which is extremely dangerous. Someone said: “For the sake of a baby calf, there is no need to risk saving it.” But if we hadn't gone to save the baby calf, it would have been stuck in the well, and it would have been difficult for these hundreds of people to drink water. A group of people stood looking at each other, looking at the calf's weak breathing, unable to struggle anymore, but no one was willing to go down to the well.

At that time, Venerable Hai Khanh was working in the village. That day, he passed by this road. Seeing such a situation, he did not hesitate to ask three brave young men to pull the rope, bring the ladder down, and he himself went down to the well. It was very difficult for Venerable Hai Khanh in the well to take off his cotton shirt to wrap it around the calf's body, then use a rope to tie it up, so that others could slowly pull the calf up. The baby calf was saved, but while pulling Dharma Master Hai Khanh up, a piece of brick fell and hit him on the head. His face was immediately stained with fresh blood. After ascending, several people came around him to bandage him. Venerable Hai Khanh smiled displeased and said: "My blood flows because the Buddha asked me to make a symbol on my face."

Next to him was a middle-aged woman named Trinh, who did not believe in Buddha. At that time, he could not help but say: “Vegetarian people chant Buddha very well!” Later, after she studied Buddhism, she was extremely respectful of the elderly and often did good deeds to help people.

A lay person said: “Khanh Cong is such a real person. He has no culture and cannot speak great principles, but during his life of practice for several decades, he always used practical actions to explain Buddha's teachings and propagate Buddha's teachings.

Many elderly lay people, when remembering Venerable Hai Khanh, all said in unison: I often see Venerable Hai Khanh carrying farming tools, chopping firewood, picking up manure, and repairing roads and bridges.

In August 1975, several days of continuous pouring rain caused the water level of a small river west of Truong village to rise, collapsing a stone bridge that was more than a hundred years old. At that time, Venerable Hai Khanh was still in the production team and a number of villagers together brought ropes and steel fibers to the rescue. But dozens of people worked hard all morning but could not repair the stone bridge, because a thousand-pound stone drifted into the mud more than five meters away from the bridge. Everyone said that if this stone was not moved here, this bridge would be forever destroyed.

While everyone was depressed and disappointed, Venerable Hai Khanh slowly said: “It's almost noon, let me try! We will not let people in this place face difficulties because there is no bridge to cross." Venerable Hai Khanh is not embarrassed when dealing with things, calm and leisurely, not afraid of hardships. He silently observed meticulously the stone falling into the mud, talking silently in his mouth for a while (in fact, everyone knew that he was reciting "A Di"

Da Buddha", but the policy at that time did not allow it, it was impossible to recite Buddha out loud), then used a steel wire and two large wooden sticks, actually prying the stone out of the settled mud. I just saw that rock rolling a few times, leaning against the side of the bridge pillar.

Everyone was especially surprised! Someone asked Dharma Master Hai Khanh how he could do that. He humbly smiled and said: “That's all Amitabha Buddha's blessings!”

At that time, the main road was still a dirt road. Every time it rained, the road surface was flooded, so we could often see Venerable Hai Khanh carrying a shovel to repair the road. He did not like to gossip, much less boast about his own merits. After coming home late from work, I eat some cold rice. Sometimes when I don't even have cold rice left, I eat some cold mantau. At that time, the rural government was moved by Him, when meeting, he called on everyone to learn from Master Hai Khanh of Lai Buddha Pagoda.

The period of life was extremely difficult during the three difficult years of Venerable Hai Khanh, often rescuing the poor. He was on the side of the main road giving porridge and water to passersby. He himself lacked food and drank little, but was often hungry and gave food and drink to others. These actions are known to all indigenous elders.

At that time, when Venerable Hai Khanh ate rice, he used thatch grass to make a bowl. He himself cleared a piece of wasteland and planted some sweet potatoes and sorghum. Many people still remember that he often steamed sweet potatoes himself or mixed wild vegetables into sago porridge, using a bowl of thatch grass to feed passersby.

When Lai Phat Pagoda was first reconstructed, there were only 3 small rooms with thatched grass, a small pan, and cooking rice with the help of thatched grass roots. Life was very difficult to maintain. But Venerable Hai Khanh still persisted in boiling water, then soaking willow leaves in a clay pot for passersby to drink. The old Dharma protector of the Party many years later asked Venerable Hai Khanh: “How can He endure such miserable days?” Old Venerable Hai Khanh said: “It's all thanks to Amitabha Buddha!”

The consequences of His good deeds have invisibly and profoundly influenced the people in this direction. On the 1st and 15th of each month, everyone goes to worship the body of Venerable Hai Khanh; Anyone who has a difficult problem will come to humiliate this Bodhisattva.

Just like the old Venerable Hai Hien, the old Venerable Hai Khanh also did not leave the Buddha Dharma but practiced the worldly Dharma, did not leave the worldly Dharma but realized the Buddha Dharma. Looking at the words and actions when he was in this world, that is called true practice. Practice is not about reciting thousands of Buddha's names in one day, reciting how many sutras, no, starting the mind to meditate, his language creations are all in accordance with Bodhisattva.

Venerable Hai Khanh also did not go to school and was illiterate. He recited the phrase "Amitabha Buddha" to the end. Except for the Buddha's name, he has nothing. He is the standard of an in-depth, lifelong practice.

After his rebirth, he left behind an indestructible flesh body and entire body of relics, this is also proof for us: A single Buddha's name can do a great thing, a great accomplishment, a great salvation, without the need for sutras, this Buddha's name can do it all!

Previously committed sins, light ones are eliminated, heavy ones are transformed into light ones.
